collection.title: Ford C-Max C-Max MPV 2011 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford C-Max 2011 - 2015 version requires a 29" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 25" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this C-Max which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
